recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, 1960s-style cel animation composition featuring a group of prehistoric characters in a stone-wheeled vehicle, set against a stylized landscape with a rock house and pink palm trees under a bright blue sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Characters grouped tightly within the central vehicle
Large, jagged display text at the top as a primary anchor
Secondary text layered over the vehicle's front panel
Background elements like the rock house and palms framing the central group
coreInvariants: Thick black ink outlines on all characters and objects
Flat, saturated color fills with minimal shading
Jagged, stone-like texture for primary display lettering
Bright blue sky with a large, subtle circular gradient or moon-like shape

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The character group in the vehicle is centered and occupies the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, yellow, jagged title at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down through the character faces, and rests on the descriptive text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open blue sky in the upper corners provides breathing room for the title and logo box.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue background and yellow vehicle/title.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pink palm fronds and red character hair provide warm contrast against the blue.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and black for secondary text elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with high value contrast between black outlines and bright fills.

letterConstructionRules: Jagged, chiseled edges resembling broken stone
Inconsistent baseline and varying letter heights
Thick black drop shadow for depth
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters have internal 'cracks' or texture lines
The 'I' and 'L' are often tilted or interlocking
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, textured display face paired with a clean, legible rounded sans-serif for information.
graphicDevices: Black border box for top-left character icon
Thick outlines to separate characters from background

preserve: Jagged stone texture of the main title
Magenta color for the secondary title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the chiseled, prehistoric feel with high legibility.
Matches the friendly, rounded retro-cartoon aesthetic for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1960s cel-animated style scene of a prehistoric family in a stone car. Include a rock house with a blue door, pink palm trees, and a bright blue sky with a large white circular glow. Use thick black outlines and flat colors.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, yellow, jagged 'stone-textured' title at the top with a heavy black shadow. Add three lines of bold magenta rounded text on the front of the stone car, followed by two lines of black rounded text at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Are all characters outlined in thick black ink?
Is the main title yellow with a jagged, chiseled appearance?
Is the secondary text magenta and centered on the vehicle?
Does the background feature pink palm trees and a rock house?

adjustableVariables: Number of characters in the vehicle
Specific landscape features (e.g., volcanoes vs palms)
Text color for the secondary title
mustRedesign: Specific character likenesses to avoid copyright
The specific logo in the top-left corner
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent line weight across all elements
Ensure text is legible against the background colors
Verify the 'chiseled' look of the main display font
Confirm the presence of the retro-style sky gradient
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Prehistoric Theme] + [1960s Cel Animation Style] + [Chiseled Stone Typography] + [Saturated Primary Palette] to create a retro-cartoon aesthetic.
